entities.name: Elizabeth Holloway Marston

entities.summary: Sarah Elizabeth Marston  was an American attorney and psychologist. She is credited, with her husband William Moulton Marston, with the development of the systolic blood pressure measurement used to detect deception, the predecessor to the polygraph.
